stages.legendary: The yard is now enclosed: two storeys of dark oak frame on a stone base, the fence replaced by a real wall open to the front, a timber gallery above, a new very tall steep roof framed with its central bay left open, the whole hall rising far higher than the old yard. Ground of bare packed earth with a few stones, no tall grass at the edge. In the centre the dummy has grown to reach the gallery, built up of oak beams and iron bands, still wearing a big iron bucket. Ropes taut on frames, pull-up bars, stones in a row, a low ember glow in the seams of its iron bands, the first hint of magic. stages.mythic: Edit this concept, the variant with a real roof. Keep the dark oak and stone hall, open on the front, the racks of practice weapons, stones and weights. Remove all figures. Make it a true great training hall, spectacular: three storeys of dark oak frame and stone, with galleries and tall windows lit warm, rows of pull-up bars, climbing ropes taut from floor to rafters, rings on rigid frames, lifting stones in rising sizes. Go much further: in its centre stands a titanic iron-bound combat dummy, no face, arms crossed, so huge it rises through an opening in the high roof ridge, its shoulders and giant iron bucket helmet its torso bursting through the roof, its shoulders, arms and giant iron bucket helmet standing outside in the open sky, fully as tall again as the whole hall below. Rivers of ember light run in the iron seams of its chest, and a furnace glow in its chest shines into the hall, strong by day and night. Clearly a place where one trains, nothing looks like treasure. Keep the iso angle, ink outlines and top-left warm light; same footprint, growth goes upward only; ground patch feathered into natural ground, no diamond edge. No people, no figures of any kind. No letters, runes or glyphs. No loose drooping cloth, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow, no grey smoke sheet. Matte paint, no gloss, no gilding. The dummy is a full two times taller than the hall: from the chest up it stands clear above the roof ridge in the open sky, a true colossus beside a small hall.
